note: Copy outside the repository and keep it untracked. endpoint is an already-running operator-owned Codex app-server; this module never starts, stops or restarts it. hostEndpoint and credentialFile refer to the Rust module host IPC. tokenEnv is optional and names the environment variable holding the app-server bearer token; the token itself is never stored here or logged. The host supplies ELIOT_SWARM_MODULE_STATE and ELIOT_SWARM_MODULE_OWNER.
